name: PinFiles
line: Pin the files you keep reopening, then open any of them in two keystrokes.

news.text: A short welcome on first run, and pinfiles update, which checks the download's checksum before installing.

name: Fahh editor
line: A code editor that plays a sound the moment your code breaks.

news.text: A three-step welcome on first launch; reopen it any time with Show Welcome.

name: CmdPop
line: A hotkey that pops up your shell history so you can find that command again.

news.text: A first-run welcome, a hint when your history is empty, and cmdpop update.

name: clix
line: One terminal for all your AI command-line tools.

news.text: clix init sets you up once; keys now live in one private per-user file; clix update gets the latest.

name: OmniDoc
line: Edit and convert documents in the browser, with your own AI key.

news.text: A first-visit tour that ends on a sample document you can edit straight away.

name: Grimoire
line: Describe an app in plain English and get a working repo.

news.text: First-visit setup for your GitHub token and AI key, ending on a sample incantation.

name: Roundtable
line: A shared coding room where each person brings their own AI.

news.text: Notes you can say to the table without starting an agent, Groq, OpenRouter and NVIDIA keys, and a first sit-down welcome.

name: Snap Judge
line: Ask many models the same typed question and see where they agree.

news.text: A first-visit tour with a starter question and a plain explanation of every result column.

name: localhost AI hub
line: One dashboard for every AI service running on your machine.

news.text: A welcome that checks whether Ollama is running and takes you to pick your first model.

name: Waifu Studio
line: Design a desktop character companion and give it a voice.

name: Wallpaper Flow
line: Arrange your desktop icons around what matters in your wallpaper.

news.text: Coming in the next download: works across several monitors, a monitor picker, and one-click undo.

name: Harness
line: Chat with your local AI agents and watch them from your phone.

news.text: Redesigned as a quiet instrument panel for phone and desktop.

name: No-code app builder
line: Build a desktop app by describing it, tested on Windows, macOS and Linux.
